name: webgpu-core
description: RN-free WebGPU core (Dawn + JSI) with native iOS example

scripts.configure:ios: cmake -S . -B build-ios -G Xcode -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="$(xcrun --find clang)" -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="$(xcrun --find clang++)" -DCMAKE_OBJC_COMPILER="$(xcrun --find clang)" -DCMAKE_OBJCXX_COMPILER="$(xcrun --find clang++)" -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=iOS -DCMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT=iphonesimulator -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=arm64 -DCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=15.0
scripts.build:ios: xcodebuild -project build-ios/webgpu_native.xcodeproj -scheme ios-native-example -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build-ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.run:ios: open -a Simulator && xcrun simctl boot D176E1C7-77A4-4679-94AB-CD3C84FD0CD2 || true && xcrun simctl bootstatus D176E1C7-77A4-4679-94AB-CD3C84FD0CD2 -b && xcrun simctl install D176E1C7-77A4-4679-94AB-CD3C84FD0CD2 build-ios/ios-native-example/Debug-iphonesimulator/ios-native-example.app && xcrun simctl launch D176E1C7-77A4-4679-94AB-CD3C84FD0CD2 com.webgpu.iosnativeexample
